recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future additions or corrections to passport identifier systems should be handled through THO/TSMG unless a later FHIR-core issue changes the policy that core delegates shared Identifier.system registry content to THO.
issue_request: FHIR-19671 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to define a passport SID pattern and document it on the identifier registry page, recommending http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/passport-xxx where xxx is the ISO three-character country code.
initial_application: Commit 35313f65769ab11a2a4963c79fc10c3d389e9165 applied the issue in core by adding a Passport Numbers NamingSystem to source/namingsystem/namingsystem-registry.xml with type PPN, OID root 2.16.840.1.113883.4.330, and URI pattern http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/passport-[XXX].
additional_context: FHIR-35932 later moved concrete identifier-system registry content out of core and into HL7 Terminology, UP-285 implemented the THO migration and generated country-specific passport NamingSystems because THO cannot represent patterned URIs, and FHIR-37889 removed duplicate core NamingSystem registry bundles to avoid stale authority. Current source/identifier-registry.html is active in the terminology module and directs implementers to THO and TSMG policy; THO passport pages such as passportNumNS-USA and passportNumNS-IND expose preferred URIs like http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/passport-USA and http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/passport-IND.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing passport rows or a passport-specific table in core would conflict with the later migration to THO, while the authoritative THO entries already preserve the requested ISO alpha-3 passport SID pattern.
